description: Reply to a customer support request.
html_content:
Hi {first_name},

Thanks for reaching out — sorry for the trouble. I had a look at your account and here's what I found:

{issue_summary}

To resolve this, please try the following:

  1. Log out and back in to refresh your session
  2. Clear your browser cache
  3. Try the action again

If the issue continues, just reply with a screenshot or short description and I'll dig in further.

Thanks for your patience,
